SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_9 = ' '
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'DDGR' AS BUYER, 'KM' AS SITE, ISNULL(PLANT,'01') AS PLANT, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ISNULL(KEPTRXL.STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, ISNULL(ITEM_NO,' ') AS REF_IF_NO, ISNULL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL(ITEM_AMT,0) AS ITEM_AMT, ISNULL(ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, ISNULL(RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, ISNULL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, ISNULL(PURCHASER_USER_ID,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, ISNULL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK, ISNULL(DESCRIPTION,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, ISNULL(SPECIFICATION,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, ISNULL(UNIT_MEASURE,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM KEPTRXL LEFT JOIN V_KEP_PO ON KEPTRXL.KEY_1 = V_KEP_PO.LEGACY_PO_NO AND KEPTRXL.KEY_2 = V_KEP_PO.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_9 = ' ' ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = GETDATE() WHERE 1=1 AND DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_9 = ' '
